title: About Me
text: I am an Industrial Engeneering & Operations Analytics student at the University of Arkansas. Most of my time is spent balancing student life along with being an resident assistant at Gatewood Dormitory. As far as extracurricular go, I am apart of NSBE (National Society of Black Engineers) and I am a Honors ambassador. I am proficient in R-studio, Excel, Intellij, Java, and Python. In my free time I am an avid creator, utilizing my divergent thinking skills to do visual art and writing. This has led me to have a work of mine published.
